title: What a Canadian invoice states for GST/HST
source: Input Tax Credit Information (GST/HST) Regulations, SOR/91-45, s. 3, current to 2026-09-30: under $100, from $100, from $500. Revenu Québec's QST registration number, cited. Read 2026-10-09.

rules.text: The supplier's name, the date and the total; from $100 the GST/HST registration number and each tax; from $500 the buyer's name and the terms of payment; untaxed lines marked; the QST number when QST is charged, on the page.
